title: T 3×N Terminal L0 Profiles

generalized_gate_theorem.statement: A state P is a predecessor of state 0 iff P has L1=L2=∅ and the remaining L0 cells (a·b - |P.L0|) can be tiled by flat T orientations (z-span=1, 5 cells each).

two_stage_obstruction.type_A: No reachable state with L1=L2=∅ has L0 ≡ a·b (mod 5)
two_stage_obstruction.type_B: Reachable state exists with L0 ≡ a·b (mod 5) but remaining cells cannot be tiled by flat T pieces

3×9.obstruction_type: A (no reachable state with L0 ≡ 2 mod 5)

3×11.obstruction_type: B (viable L0 exists but remaining cells untileable by flat T)

3×12.obstruction_type: B (viable L0 exists but remaining cells untileable by flat T)

arithmetic_progression_pattern.description: Viable L0 values form an arithmetic progression: L0 = k, k+5, k+10, ... where k is the minimal reachable L0 ≡ a·b (mod 5)

s_pentacube_comparison.note: S has no flat orientations. The only predecessor of 0 is (FULL,0,0). No L1=L2=0 states with L0>0 are reachable in first-gen BFS for any S cross-section.
